quote: We shipped for two years without telling anyone. Signal turned our merge history into a changelog our customers actually bookmark — support tickets asking “did you fix X?” basically vanished.
name: Mara Chen

quote: The drafts are shockingly good. It reads the PR, skips the refactor noise, and writes the sentence I would have written — twenty minutes of dread down to one approve click.
name: Eli Ambrose

quote: The widget pays for itself. Feature adoption on new releases doubled once What's New started badging inside the app instead of dying in an email nobody opens.
name: Priya Raghavan
